Population increased in the Vale of Glamorgan

The estimated population of the Vale of Glamorgan in 2024 was 135,743 usual residents, a rise of 0.7% since 2023.

This meant that the Vale of Glamorgan's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of the Vale of Glamorgan increased by 2.5%.

Over this slightly longer period, the Vale of Glamorgan was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of the Vale of Glamorgan

The average (median) age rose to 44.2 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of the Vale of Glamorgan has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
The Vale of Glamorgan is an area that is classed as intermediate urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, the Vale of Glamorgan's population of 135,743 usual residents was made up of:

  • 24,591 people aged 0 to 15 years, (18.1%)
  • 80,298 people aged 16 to 64 years, (59.2%)
  • 30,854 people aged 65 years and over, (22.7%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, the Vale of Glamorgan has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (22.7% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In the Vale of Glamorgan, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in the Vale of Glamorgan
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for the Vale of Glamorgan, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 221 people (-0.2%). In total, there were 1,119 births and 1,340 deaths in the Vale of Glamorgan.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 823 (0.6%). There were 5,571 people entering the area and 4,748 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in the Vale of Glamorgan's population of 537 (0.4%) as a result of 782 people entering the area and 245 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for the Vale of Glamorgan was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of the Vale of Glamorgan in mid-2023 is 134,771.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 132 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 94 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 38 people.
